The '''Revanite compound''' was the headquarters of the [[Order of Revan]], located on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], capital of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The camp was set far off the beaten path along the [[Riverfall Wilds]] to prevent strangers from locating it or trespassing inside. It was set a few hundred meters away from a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] housing a [[Revanite Shrine]].
